package domain

import (
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	PracticeLearningReadinessRequestSchemaV1 = "practice-learning-readiness-reconcile.v1"
	PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptSchemaV1 = "practice-learning-readiness-receipt.v1"
	PracticeReadinessReady                   = "READY"
	PracticeReadinessNotReady                = "NOT_READY"
)

type PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1 struct {
	Schema             string `json:"schema"`
	TaskInstanceID     string `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID          string `json:"student_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest string `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	RouteID            string `json:"route_id"`
	RouteDigest        string `json:"route_digest"`
	StepID             string `json:"step_id"`
}

type PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1 struct {
	Schema             string    `json:"schema"`
	ID                 string    `json:"id"`
	TaskInstanceID     string    `json:"task_instance_id"`
	StudentID          string    `json:"student_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string    `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest string    `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	RouteID            string    `json:"route_id"`
	RouteDigest        string    `json:"route_digest"`
	StepID             string    `json:"step_id"`
	Decision           string    `json:"decision"`
	LearnerStateDigest string    `json:"learner_state_digest"`
	MasteryPolicy      string    `json:"mastery_policy_version"`
	ObservedAt         time.Time `json:"observed_at"`
}

type PracticeLearningReadinessRecord struct {
	IdempotencyKey string
	RequestHash    string
	Receipt        PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1
}

var readinessDigestPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

func NormalizePracticeLearningReadinessRequest(input PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1) (PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.TaskInstanceID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID))
	input.StudentID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID))
	input.TaskRevisionID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID))
	input.TaskRevisionDigest = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionDigest))
	input.RouteID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.RouteID))
	input.RouteDigest = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.RouteDigest))
	input.StepID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.StepID))
	if input.Schema != PracticeLearningReadinessRequestSchemaV1 || !validPracticeUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) ||
		!validPracticeUUID(input.StudentID) || !validPracticeUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) || !validPracticeUUID(input.RouteID) ||
		!readinessDigestPattern.MatchString(input.TaskRevisionDigest) || !readinessDigestPattern.MatchString(input.RouteDigest) ||
		!practiceIDPattern.MatchString(input.StepID) {
		return PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func ValidPracticeLearningReadinessReceipt(input PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptV1) bool {
	return input.Schema == PracticeLearningReadinessReceiptSchemaV1 && validPracticeUUID(input.ID) &&
		validPracticeUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) && validPracticeUUID(input.StudentID) &&
		validPracticeUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) && validPracticeUUID(input.RouteID) &&
		readinessDigestPattern.MatchString(input.TaskRevisionDigest) && readinessDigestPattern.MatchString(input.RouteDigest) &&
		readinessDigestPattern.MatchString(input.LearnerStateDigest) &&
		(input.Decision == PracticeReadinessReady || input.Decision == PracticeReadinessNotReady) &&
		input.MasteryPolicy == StudentMasteryPolicyVersion && !input.ObservedAt.IsZero()
}
